auth-setting-cleanup.title: Auth Setting Cleanup (mode/provider/model separation)
auth-setting-cleanup.description: Flatten mode×provider into a single LLMProvider enum; consolidate all cloud credentials (OAuth + ApiKey) into one AuthStore; eliminate buildApiKeys fallback chain and __AUTH_METHOD_OPENAI magic key; bump SessionRuntimeSnapshot schemaVersion; no runtime migration (pre-release one-time re-auth on upgrade). Fixes Codex OAuth → Run Demo failure.
acceptCriteria: All child tasks done
Onboarding OAuth → Run Demo succeeds on device
Onboarding API key → Run Demo succeeds
Upgrade from prior build → empty AuthStore → banner → Settings re-auth path works
auth-setting-cleanup.note: v4 design (KISS, zero migration). Reviewed by Codex v1 + v2. Ready for orchestrate.

auth-store-core.title: AuthStore + AuthCredential + AuthErrors
auth-store-core.description: New unified credential store keyed by flat LLMProvider. Sealed AuthCredential = ApiKey | OAuth. Internal Mutex guards OAuth refresh. codexHeaders() returns full {accessToken, chatgptAccountId, email} bundle. Encrypted-prefs backed with in-memory fallback on crypto failure (same pattern as existing OAuthCredentialStore). Per-provider generation counter for cache invalidation.
acceptCriteria: AuthStore.kt, AuthCredential.kt, AuthErrors.kt exist
get/set/clear/has work for all cloud providers
codexHeaders() refreshes near expiry under mutex
Wrong credential type clears store and throws WrongCredentialType
Encryption-degraded mode uses in-memory fallback
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests ai.closepaw.auth.AuthStoreTest passes

provider-enum-split.title: Flatten LLMProvider enum + split catalog
provider-enum-split.description: Rename OPENAI→OPENAI_API; add OPENAI_CODEX; add provider.mode accessor returning AuthMode. Split llm_models.json: OpenAI RESPONSE models get -codex variants under OPENAI_CODEX. Add catalog.defaultModel(provider) helper.
acceptCriteria: Enum contains OPENAI_API, OPENAI_CODEX, OPENROUTER, NOVITA, LOCAL_LFM
provider.mode returns correct AuthMode for each
gpt-5.4 resolves under OPENAI_API, gpt-5.4-codex under OPENAI_CODEX
catalog.defaultModel(OPENAI_CODEX) returns a valid -codex model key
./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin succeeds

factory-rewrite.title: LLMClientFactory by-provider routing + Codex header supplier
factory-rewrite.description: Factory routes purely on entry.provider. CodexResponseClient accepts suspend () -> CodexHeaders supplier instead of captured accessToken/accountId. ApiKey providers use generation counter for cache invalidation; Codex cache also invalidates on OAuth set/clear. Delete apiKeyResolver, resolveApiKey, isOAuth, __AUTH_METHOD_OPENAI.
acceptCriteria: Factory resolves client purely from entry.provider (no env-var sniffing)
CodexResponseClient has no captured OAuth state; reads headers via supplier per request
ApiKey cache invalidates on authStore.set via generation mismatch
__AUTH_METHOD_OPENAI constant removed from codebase
MissingCredential / OAuthRefreshFailed / WrongCredentialType thrown at correct sites
Factory unit tests pass

runtime-wiring.title: Runtime wiring: session boot, checkpoint schema, banner deep-link
runtime-wiring.description: Update all session/main-activity callsites to resolve credentials via AuthStore (not apiKeys map / env vars). Bump SessionRuntimeSnapshot.schemaVersion 1→2; AgentSession.reload rejects v1 snapshots with user message. ChatViewModel.reportStartupFailure banner payload carries openSettingsAt(page=LLM_AUTH, tab=mode) action. SmartCapsuleSurface banner becomes tappable; ChatScreen/MainActivityContent route the action to SettingsSheet. Debug intent handlers write credentials to AuthStore; openai_base_url moves to AppSettingsState.openAiBaseUrlOverride.
acceptCriteria: No callsite reads appSettings.authMethod / openAiOAuthAccessToken / openAiManualApiKey / apiKey / openRouterApiKey / novitaApiKey / buildApiKeys
SessionCheckpointCoordinator writes schemaVersion=2; AgentSession.reload returns null for schemaVersion==1 snapshots
Startup failure banner is tappable and opens SettingsSheet on correct LLM auth tab
Debug intent api_key/openrouter_api_key/novita_api_key write to AuthStore; openai_base_url writes to openAiBaseUrlOverride
./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin succeeds

settings-ui-align.title: Settings UI tab canonicalization + executor model safety
settings-ui-align.description: LlmAuthSettingsPage: tabs drive selectedProviderForTab via canonicalization rule (if selectedModel.provider.mode != tab.mode, use tab default provider). Tab switch itself is inert — no writes until model commit. On model commit, executorModel is reset/remapped if its provider no longer matches selectedModel.provider. SettingsSheet accepts initialPage + initialAuthTab for deep-link.
acceptCriteria: Tab switch writes nothing to settings state until a model pick is committed
Selecting OAuth tab while selectedModel is OPENAI_API shows OPENAI_CODEX provider by default
Changing main model provider resets executorModel when provider mismatches
SettingsSheet(initialPage=LLM_AUTH, initialAuthTab=OAUTH) opens correct tab
SettingsLlmAuthTest updated and passes on device

onboarding-rewrite.title: Onboarding rewrite: AuthStore writes, no drafts, transient text
onboarding-rewrite.description: OnboardingViewModel: OAuth success writes authStore.set(OPENAI_CODEX); API key text is ViewModel-transient (no encrypted draft); Next/Run Demo commits to AuthStore. OnboardingStore: delete KEY_AUTH_METHOD, KEY_API_KEY_DRAFT, onboarding_secure_prefs entirely. Step-resume derives mode from selectedModel.provider.mode + AuthStore.has(). OnboardingState cloud provider enum aligned with flat LLMProvider. MissingCredential / OAuthRefreshFailed render inline error card with re-auth action.
acceptCriteria: OnboardingStore has no KEY_AUTH_METHOD or KEY_API_KEY_DRAFT
OAuth completion results in authStore.has(OPENAI_CODEX) == true
ApiKey typed text not persisted across process death
Step-resume does not call loadAuthMethod() or loadApiKeyDraft()
Run Demo succeeds end-to-end on device for both OAuth and API key paths
Missing credential surfaces inline error card with re-auth action
